description: The SDD spec for this talk: the versioned source of truth agents implement from. REQ-001 is the finished Contacts CRUD baseline. REQ-002 (CSV export) is drafted live with JFrog MCP as the package gate, then turned into Gherkin and JUnit before any new library hits the POM.

requirements.title: Contacts can be created, read, listed, replaced and deleted
requirements.story: As an operator of the contacts service, I want to create, read, list, replace and delete contacts so that the address book stays accurate without rebuilding the API during the talk.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the contacts API is running, when I create a contact with a unique email, then the response status is 201 and the body includes that email
Given a stored contact, when I fetch it by id, then the response status is 200 and the body includes that contact's email
Given seeded contacts exist, when I list contacts, then the response status is 200 and the list is not empty
